camel_example: aliyun edas GET /pop/v5/k8s/app_precheck --region cn-hangzhou --ClusterId 'c37aec2a-bcca-4ec1-0000-000000000000' --Namespace default --AppName testapp --header "Content-Type=application/json"
description_en: Queries the precheck result of a Kubernetes application
description_zh: 调用GetK8sAppPrecheckResult接口获取K8s应用预检结果
kebab_example: aliyun edas get-k8s-app-precheck-result --cluster-id c37aec2a-bcca-4ec1-0000-000000000000 --namespace default --app-name testapp --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetK8sAppPrecheckResult

parameters.help_en: The ID of the cluster in Enterprise Distributed Application Service (EDAS)
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The namespace of the Kubernetes cluster
parameters.name: namespace

schema.description_en: The information about the application change precheck

Code.description_en: The HTTP status code that is returned

JobResults.description_en: The precheck result for the application change

items.description_en: The object data of the precheck result for the application change
items.description_zh: 应用变更预检结果对象

Interrupted.description_en:
Specifies whether the precheck of the item was interrupted:

true: The precheck of the item was interrupted.

false: The precheck of the item was not interrupted
Interrupted.description_zh:
预检任务项是否被中断：

true：任务被中断。
false：任务未被中断

Name.description_en: The name of the precheck item

Pass.description_en:
Indicates whether the precheck item passed the precheck:

true: The precheck item passed the precheck.

false: The precheck item failed the precheck
Pass.description_zh:
预检任务项是否通过预检：

true：通过预检。
false：未通过预检

Reason.description_en: The reason why the precheck item failed the precheck or the precheck of the item was interrupted. This parameter is left empty when the application passed the precheck
Reason.description_zh: 应用变更预检项未通过或被中断的原因说明。预检通过时该字段为空

Reason.description_en: The reason why the application failed the precheck. This parameter is left empty when the application passed the precheck
Reason.description_zh: 应用变更预检未通过的原因说明。预检通过时该字段为空

Status.description_en:
The precheck state for the application change. Valid values:

checking: The application is being prechecked.

pass: The application passed the precheck.

failed: The application failed the precheck
Status.description_zh:
应用变更预检状态：
checking：检查中。
pass：通过检查。
failed：未通过检查

Message.description_en: The additional information that is returned
